body: Scope expanded by project decision: this mission now establishes an operational self-hosting alpha with policy amendment tooling, planned key rotation and distinct device actors, selective bounded replication with quarantine, shallow-clone handling, and a role-distinct public workflow. Secrets, runner network/resource hardening, portable/container backends, shared moderation/redaction, and merge queues remain later focused missions.
